concepts.title: Half Right Doesn't Break Even
concepts.body: At standard −110 odds, winning half your bets does not break even. You risk $110 to win $100, so the break-even rate is about 52.4%.
concepts.takeaway: Check the break-even rate before you place the bet.
concepts.rationale: The hook challenges the familiar idea that winning half means staying level. The body shows the exact −110 assumption and the arithmetic in plain language, while the takeaway gives bettors a reusable check for any line.
concepts.caption: Winning half sounds level. At standard −110 odds, it isn't: risking $110 to win $100 puts break-even at about 52.4%. Check the rate before you place the bet. #KnowTheOdds

concepts.title: Your Number Didn't Get Luckier
concepts.body: On an American roulette wheel, every number has the same 1-in-38 chance on every spin. Past spins—and why you picked the number—do not change it.
concepts.takeaway: Keep the ritual. Know the 1-in-38 math.
concepts.rationale: The concept respects the fun of choosing a personal number while separating the ritual from probability. Naming the American-wheel assumption keeps the claim precise and turns a familiar casino moment into a shareable myth check.
concepts.caption: Birthday, jersey number, favorite number—pick the one you like. On an American roulette wheel, each still gets the same 1-in-38 chance every spin. The ritual is yours; the math stays put. #MythCheck

concepts.title: Small Spins. Full-Speed Math.
concepts.body: At $0.50 a spin every 3 seconds, you make 20 spins a minute. That is $10 wagered per minute, or $600 in an hour if the pace holds.
concepts.takeaway: Choose your pace and budget before the first spin.
concepts.rationale: Small denominations can hide the speed of total wagering. The card makes pace visible with simple arithmetic, then turns the insight into a concrete pre-session choice without promising an account control.
concepts.caption: Small bets can move at full speed. At $0.50 every 3 seconds, the pace is 20 spins and $10 wagered each minute—$600 in an hour if it holds. Pick your pace and entertainment budget first. #YourPlay
